**Finding submitted: missing (insurance clause absent).**

- **What I checked:** searched the whole document for insurance language, and reviewed the four planner candidates plus the General section (16.1–16.21).
- **What exists:** only narrow property cover — MSL's replacement-value cover for consigned Products (SOW 13.1 b)) and IBM's own tooling cover (SOW 21.2, where IBM is the insuring party). Section 8 of the Loan Agreement in fact relieves MSL of risk of loss on Loaned Items.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** there is no commercial general liability, professional liability (E&O) or cyber/privacy cover anywhere, so the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is unmet on every material term. MSL occupies IBM-leased premises, handles IBM and IBM-customer inventory, and has I/T system access — squarely the walk-away scenario.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new Section 16.22 inserted at the end of the General section at the preferred limits (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' comp, certificates on request), expressly stated to be additional to the existing consigned-inventory and tooling cover so no bargain is disturbed. The comment offers the E&O 1M / cyber 2M fallback.
